servers.description: Intent-first 1C/BSL code search and navigation backend through an RLM sandbox; prefer over raw grep for modules, methods, metadata references, forms/XML, call graphs, data paths and full-text search. Includes project registry, optional SQLite index and 61 sandbox helpers
BSL diagnostics via 1c-lsp-mcp-skill and bsl-language-server: syntax errors, warnings, analyzer remarks
1C platform syntax reference via 1c-syntax-mcp: search_syntax, get_function_info, suggest_completion, validate_syntax
1C BSL code template library via Desko77/1c-templates-mcp: templatesearch, list_templates, get_template
Graph-based metadata and BSL code search for 1C configurations (Neo4j, ROCTUP/1c-mcp-metacode)
1C Buddy gateway to 1С:Напарник: ask_1c_ai, explain_1c_syntax, check_1c_code, modify_1c_code, platform documentation and ITS search
Standard Subsystems Library (БСП / SSL) function search

Live infobase access through ROCTUP/1c-mcp-toolkit processing in TOON mode: execute_query, execute_code, get_metadata, get_event_log, object link helpers, reference search, access rights, BSL syntax help, screenshots and session helpers
